state.claim_name: Breach of Implied Warranty of Habitability
state.issue_statement: The tenant has reported ongoing mold issues and a heat outage which have resulted in conditions affecting health, indicating a failure by the landlord to maintain habitable premises.

elements.element_description: The landlord has failed to maintain the property in a habitable condition, such as providing necessary heat and addressing mold issues.
The tenant must have notified the landlord of the uninhabitable condition, which the tenant did through calls and texts.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The tenant called the city on February 20 to report the mold and no-heat issue.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The tenant called the city to report mold and no-heat issues, providing formal notice of the uninhabitable conditions to the landlord.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The tenant texted Wendell about the HEAT outage.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The tenant's communication with Wendell about the HEAT outage serves as notice of the uninhabitable condition.

elements.element_description: The landlord failed to make necessary repairs or properly address the issues after being informed.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The emergency line never picked up.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The fact that the emergency line never picked up indicates a failure in the landlord's duty to repair and maintain the property.

fact_mappings.fact_text: Someone from the city came out on February 25.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The city's involvement on February 25 indicates the issue had not been addressed by the landlord, highlighting a failure to repair.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The tenant wants the mold fixed before paying.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The tenant's refusal to pay until the mold is addressed illustrates the landlord's failure to repair the uninhabitable condition.

fact_mappings.fact_text: A technician was sent on January 23.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The technician was sent, but the continued issues indicate that necessary repairs were not adequately performed.

elements.element_description: The uninhabitable conditions have negatively impacted the tenant's health or well-being.

fact_mappings.fact_text: Marcus was sick during the HEAT outage.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: Marcus being sick during the heat outage demonstrates the negative health impact on the tenant due to uninhabitable conditions.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The tenant has 14 days to pay or move out.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: The tenant wanting the mold fixed before paying indicates health concerns, directly supporting the impact on tenant's well-being.

fact_mappings.fact_text: The tenant is holding back $300 due to mold issues.
fact_mappings.mapping_rationale: Holding back rent due to mold issues strongly suggests negative impact on the tenant's health and living condition.
